headline: Trump calls air traffic systems 'ancient' but safe after ground stop
pages: President Trump said US air traffic control systems are ancient and obsolete, at least 55 years old by his account, and pressed Congress to pay for costly upgrades. He said the system is safe but that flights move slowly because of it. His comments came a week after a four-hour ground stop on Nov. 13, the longest since the Sept. 11 attacks. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a contractor was replacing copper lines with fiber and installing a router that began flooding other parts of the network, sending about 1,000 connection attempts every four to five seconds. It is unclear whether the wire swap or a router fault was the root cause.

Seventeen of 22 air route traffic control centers had voice and ground communication problems, and it took 45 minutes to find the fault because maintenance is logged on paper. More than 15,000 flights were delayed or cancelled. Trump said the week's tech outages were separate events. Source: BBC.
